About me

I received my B.S. in Statistics from the University of Minnesota Twin Cities in May 2026, with minors in Computer Science and Mathematics. My research interests lie at the intersection of statistics, machine learning, and healthcare.

At the University of Minnesota, I work with Dr. Feng Xie on clinical machine learning and decision support. I also collaborate with Dr. Shenda Hong at Peking University on target trial emulation and antibiotic timing in sepsis. Previously, I worked with Dr. Jie Ding at the University of Minnesota on AI agents for scientific research.

I am seeking PhD opportunities in clinical AI and health data science.

Beyond research

I’m from Hubei, China.

Outside research, I enjoy playing basketball, running, working out, and hiking. I like staying active, spending time outdoors, and exploring new trails.
